name: forward-view-proof-root-later-claim
description: FORWARD tolerance for the view-origin proof's root (ggui#1415, SPEC §4.7, VERSION-POLICY §3.6): a LATER release's server may stamp its ws token's payload with a claim this release does not name (`lane`). SPEC §4.7: a reader decodes the root claims it names and ignores any others, so a v1 proof rooted in that token must still parse. A new value of the closed `src` set is deliberately NOT a forward case: §4.7 names `src` as the exception, and VERSION-POLICY §3.6 widens that set one release before any door stamps the value. Synthetic by construction.

release.label: a later ggui release (synthetic): a v1 proof whose root carries an unnamed claim
